transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Good morning, this is Rachel Moore with your eight o'clock traffic update. Traffic on Highway 9 is moving slowly this morning because of road work near the Elm Street exit, and drivers heading downtown should expect delays of about twenty minutes. If possible, take Riverside Drive instead.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Also, a reminder that the Harbor Bridge will be closed this weekend for its annual inspection, so please plan your trips accordingly. I'll be back with another update in fifteen minutes.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Attention, shoppers. Thank you for shopping at Greenway Market. For the next hour only, all fresh bakery items are twenty percent off. You'll find our bakery at the back of the store, next to the dairy section.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: And don't forget to sign up for our loyalty card at the customer service desk. Card members receive a free coffee every Monday, as well as exclusive weekly coupons. The store closes at nine o'clock tonight.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Hi, this is Karen from Brightline Printing, calling for Mr. Alvarez about your order of five hundred business cards. Unfortunately, the cream linen paper you selected is out of stock and won't be available for another two weeks.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: We do have a very similar ivory paper that we could use instead, at no extra charge, and we could deliver the cards by Thursday. Please call me back at 555-0148 to let me know which option you prefer.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome to the Hartley Chocolate Factory. My name is Ben, and I'll be your guide today. The tour lasts about forty-five minutes. We'll start in the roasting room, where the cocoa beans are prepared, and finish in our tasting room, where you'll be able to sample five of our best-selling chocolates.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: For safety reasons, please wear the hairnets we handed out at the entrance, and stay behind the yellow lines at all times. Photos are allowed everywhere except in the packaging area.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Before we finish, I'd like to share some good news. Our customer satisfaction score for the third quarter came in at ninety-two percent, the highest in the company's history. Much of that improvement is thanks to the online chat service that the support team launched in July.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Starting next month, we'll extend the chat hours until ten P.M. on weekdays. To make that possible, we'll be hiring four new support agents, so if you know anyone who might be interested, please encourage them to apply through our careers page.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Are you tired of spending your weekends cleaning? Let SparkleHome do it for you! Our trained and insured cleaners can handle everything from kitchens to windows, and we use only eco-friendly products.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Book online before the end of the month and get your first cleaning at half price. And if you're not completely satisfied, we'll come back and do it again for free. SparkleHome: because your free time matters.
